access_asset_breakdown.count_definition: unique features satisfying at least one access-asset condition

mechanism_chain: A short, intense rain pulse loaded an already broad storm footprint and produced a high station-to-area rainfall contrast.
Low pressure, rapid pressure fall, and severe gusts overlapped with rainfall for sustained compound forcing.
Population, critical facilities, and access assets convert the meteorological load into an emergency-service and lifeline problem.
SAR and annual embedding change support widespread disturbance context but do not replace the physical process evidence.
answer.final_interpretation: Cyclone Gabrielle should be treated as a compound rainfall-wind-pressure exposure event with high baseline stress and materially higher stress under the wetter, windier planning scenario.

tolerances.source_paths: package-relative paths required; exact set may vary if all values are supported

key_values.exposure_context_scope: package exposure/access statistics are used as stress-context proxies, not location-specific loss attribution

judge_anchors.expected_interpretation: compound rainfall-wind-pressure exposure stress, not a single wind or rain metric
judge_anchors.exposure_context_scope: package exposure/access statistics are stress-context proxies

criteria.name: Self-directed package discovery and citations
criteria.description: Uses the local package across narrative, meteorology, gridded precipitation, exposure, geospatial, infrastructure, and remote-sensing evidence, and cites package-relative paths for values used.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for mostly correct evidence families with incomplete path citation.

criteria.name: Event timing and hazard extraction
criteria.description: Correctly extracts the event window, reported station rainfall, reported gust and pressure anchors, point rainfall totals/windows, point gust, minimum pressure, pressure fall, and rain-wind overlap.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for correct values with one family missing or minor rounding errors.

criteria.name: Rainfall and runoff process calculations
criteria.description: Computes three-product area mean precipitation, AOI area, runoff-volume proxy, population rainfall load, station-to-area ratio, rainfall normalizations, and rainfall stress.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points if formulas are right but one derived value is wrong.

criteria.name: Wind-pressure forcing calculations
criteria.description: Applies the squared gust kinetic proxy, pressure-deficit normalization, pressure-fall normalization, and wind-pressure stress with correct clipping and rounding.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for correct extraction but flawed normalization or weighting.

criteria.name: Exposure, access, and disturbance synthesis
criteria.description: Counts critical facilities and unique access assets correctly, computes exposure-access stress as a package exposure-context proxy, and uses SAR and annual embedding change only as disturbance context.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for correct exposure or remote-sensing treatment but not both.

criteria.name: Index, scenario, and priority ranking
criteria.description: Computes the baseline compound index, the +12%/+15%/+10% scenario index and delta, and ranks the three response priorities correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points if the baseline index is correct but scenario or ranking has an error.

criteria.name: Disaster-process interpretation and valid JSON
criteria.description: Returns valid structured JSON and gives a concise mechanism chain explaining compound rainfall, wind-pressure, exposure/access, and disturbance processes without generic unsupported claims.
criteria.partial_credit: One point for valid JSON with weak process interpretation, or strong interpretation in imperfect JSON.
